$schema.description: Optional path or URL of the JSON Schema, for editors, e.g. https://archipen.dev/schema/archipen.schema.json.

version.description: File format version. Currently 1; files with a newer version are refused.

id.description: Diagram id. Generated on load if missing or empty.

settings.description: All fields optional; missing ones take the built-in defaults.

side.description: Which side of the item the label sits on, in the text’s own frame.

orientation.description: How the text is drawn: "screen" faces the viewer; "ground-x"/"ground-y" lie flat on the ground along that axis; "wall-x"/"wall-y" stand upright along that axis.

inside.description: Place the label just inside the item’s outline instead of outside.

offset.description: Distance from the outline, in px.

showDescription.description: Also show the item’s description under its name.

shape.description: "block" box, "cylinder" (databases), "flat" tile on the ground, "icon" just the icon.

styles.description: Diagram-wide style defaults. Items inherit any style field they don’t set themselves.

pages.description: The pages, in order. The first one opens first.

name.description: Shown in the page list and next to the diagram name.
